profile_text: Specializing in recruitment and staffing services, this agency has experienced rapid growth of 88.9% due to its expertise in connecting employers with qualified job candidates across various industries. With a focus on tailored recruitment solutions, the company has expanded its team to 34 employees in 2024, earning its classification as a Gazelle. By leveraging its industry knowledge and networking capabilities, the agency continues to thrive in the professional, scientific, and technical activities sector.
